questions.q: What documents do I need to rent a car in Nepal?
questions.a: Documents are required only for self-drive rentals — a valid driving license, citizenship or passport (for foreign nationals), and a security deposit. For chauffeur-driven rentals, no documents are needed from the customer.

questions.q: Can I rent a car without a driver?
questions.a: Yes, self-drive car rental is available for licensed drivers. A chauffeur-driven option is also available on request.

questions.q: Is fuel included in the car rental price?
questions.a: We offer both fuel-included and fuel-excluded packages, but most of our rentals are served with fuel included for your convenience. You can choose the option that best fits your trip.

questions.q: How do I book a car rental online?
questions.a: Simply select your car, choose your pick-up and drop-off dates, and confirm your booking through our website or a quick phone call.

questions.q: Are your SUVs suitable for hill and mountain routes?
questions.a: Yes, our SUVs are well-suited for hilly terrain, off-road conditions, and long-distance travel across Nepal.

questions.q: How many passengers can an SUV rental accommodate?
questions.a: Our SUVs comfortably seat 5 to 7 passengers, depending on the model.

questions.q: Do you provide a driver with SUV rental?
questions.a: Yes, professional drivers are available with SUV rental, or you can opt for self-drive if licensed.

questions.q: What is the minimum rental duration for an SUV?
questions.a: SUVs can be rented for a single day or for extended weekly and monthly durations based on your travel needs.

questions.q: Are jeeps good for off-road and trekking routes?
questions.a: Yes, our jeeps are built for rough terrain and are ideal for off-road adventures and remote trekking access points.

questions.q: Do jeeps come with 4-wheel drive?
questions.a: Most of our jeeps offer 4WD capability for better handling on difficult and uneven roads.

questions.q: How many people can travel in a jeep rental?
questions.a: Our jeeps typically accommodate 4 to 6 passengers comfortably, along with luggage space.

questions.q: Can I rent a jeep for a multi-day trip?
questions.a: Yes, jeep rentals are available for both short trips and multi-day adventure travel across Nepal.

questions.q: How many passengers can a Hiace hold?
questions.a: Our Hiace vans comfortably seat up to 12 passengers, making them ideal for group travel.

questions.q: Is Hiace rental suitable for airport transfers?
questions.a: Yes, Hiace rental is a popular choice for airport pick-up and drop-off services for groups and families.

questions.q: Does Hiace rental come with a driver?
questions.a: Yes, all Hiace rentals include an experienced driver for a safe and comfortable journey.

questions.q: Can I rent a Hiace for multi-day tours?
questions.a: Yes, Hiace rental is available for both single-day trips and extended multi-day tour packages.

questions.q: How many passengers does a coaster accommodate?
questions.a: Our coasters seat 20 to 25 passengers, making them ideal for group tours and corporate outings.

questions.q: Is coaster rental suitable for school or corporate trips?
questions.a: Yes, coaster rental is commonly used for school excursions, corporate events, and mid-sized group travel.

questions.q: Do you provide a driver with coaster rental?
questions.a: Yes, an experienced driver is included with every coaster rental booking.

questions.q: Can I book a coaster for a multi-day tour package?
questions.a: Yes, coaster rentals are available for both day trips and extended multi-day travel itineraries.

questions.q: How many passengers can your bus rental accommodate?
questions.a: Our buses accommodate 30 or more passengers, ideal for weddings, large events, and long-distance group tours.

questions.q: Is bus rental available for long-distance travel?
questions.a: Yes, our buses are well-maintained for comfortable long-distance journeys across Nepal's highways and hill routes.

questions.q: Do you offer bus rental for corporate events?
questions.a: Yes, bus rental is a popular choice for corporate outings, conferences, and large-scale event logistics.

questions.q: How far in advance should I book a bus rental?
questions.a: We recommend booking at least a few days in advance, especially during peak travel seasons, to ensure availability.

questions.q: What vehicles are included in your premium rental fleet?
questions.a: Our premium fleet includes luxury sedans and high-end SUVs suited for VIP travel and special occasions.

questions.q: Is premium rental suitable for weddings and events?
questions.a: Yes, our premium vehicles are a popular choice for weddings, corporate executives, and special occasion transport.

questions.q: Does premium rental include a chauffeur?
questions.a: Yes, all premium rentals include a professional, experienced chauffeur for a seamless experience.

questions.q: Can I book premium rental for airport transfers?
questions.a: Yes, premium rental is available for airport pick-up and drop-off with priority scheduling.
